note: Weekly target = September monthly GA4 target × 7/30. Hong Kong booked 980 GA4 bookings against an 899 blended weekly target, 9.0 percent ahead, down 7.1 percent week on week and up 25.5 percent year on year. Five of six venues beat the weekly target. Cantina (+21.5 percent) and Aqua HK (+20.5 percent) led it, and Aqua HK’s 229 is its best week of the financial year so far. Dim Sum Library (−14.4 percent) is the only venue below target this week. It and Aqua HK remain the two venues behind on the FY-to-date line (−8.4 and −5.3 percent), although Aqua HK has now beaten its weekly target for two weeks running. Year to date the portfolio is 7.0 percent ahead of target. The week-on-week fall is concentrated in Hutong HK (277 from 315) and The Chinese Library (113 from 139), both of which had unusually high traffic the week before. Hutong’s National Day firework dinner page drew 1,023 sessions this week and produced one website booking, so it is still reading as a content page rather than a booking page. Shiro is shown as two sites: Shiro Pacific Place booked 71 and Shiro Tai Kwun 68. Together that is the 139 measured against Shiro’s combined target of 118, 17.8 percent ahead. Tai Kwun opened in 2026, so it has no year-on-year comparison. Below the portfolio line, outside the target set: Vesu booked 73 against 105 the week before and 59 in the same week last year, and The Canton Library, open since 8 September, booked 46 against 31. Neither is in the portfolio total or its variance.
outside_label: Outside the target set: not in the portfolio total or its variance
foot_extra: Shiro’s weekly target of 118 (YTD 4,133) covers both sites, so the two Shiro rows carry no individual target and are measured together on the “Shiro, both sites” row. Shiro’s Meta and Google accounts are shared by both sites, so Shiro ad spend is shown once on that row and never split. The Canton Library’s cost per booking leaves out its awareness campaign spend; its Google Ads account has no booking conversion. Targets for Vesu and The Canton Library are not set yet.
